subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should maintainers keep this draft as the combined live proof target, accept internal/scheduler proof instead, or close it in favor of the split PRs?
rationale: The available Mantis artifact did not start the generated-image scenario, while the branch intentionally combines two open landing boundaries plus one stack-only commit.

options.title: Keep As Proof Target
options.body: Leave the draft open until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show baseline missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Accept Internal Proof
options.body: Maintainers can decide scheduler-level proof is enough and proceed with the split implementation and harness PRs without requiring this draft to produce visible Telegram media proof.

options.title: Close The Draft Stack
options.body: If combined proof is no longer useful or the runner cannot exercise it, close this draft and keep review focused on the split PRs.

recommendation.title: Keep As Proof Target
recommendation.body: Leave the draft open until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs show baseline missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily about Telegram/Mantis proof harness behavior and proof sufficiency, where recent history points to vincentkoc.
